Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
oac3...@rosie.uh.edu (Octavious Chacon) writes:

>When a vampire is Banished, you know turn over the card and stuff, what happens?
>Is there a way to un bannish him?

The key is that you turn over the card "and place it into your inactive
region". The banished vampire, like any other vampire in your inactive
region, will return to the active region at the end of your influence phase
if he has at least as many blood (influence) counters on him as his
capacity.

If the banished vampire was full, he'll return automatically at the end
of your next influence phase (unless you take some transfers to move
blood off of him, of course). If not, you'll have to take some transfers
to move blood onto him, just like you did when you first brought him out.
